subject: Lumilist — credit hold & invoice reissue plan
messages:
From: Maya Irwin <maya.irwin@lumilist.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Unexpected spike on Jan invoice — hold request

Hi Sofia,

We noticed a ~420% spike on invoice INV-202601 vs prior month (see attached). Our engineering team is looking into a migration traffic spike, but AP has put the invoice on hold while we validate the usage lines and confirm VAT handling for this region. Can you put a temporary credit hold on the outstanding balance while we gather PO and VAT docs?

AP contact: accounts-payable@lumilist.com
PO (internal ref): LUM-PO-3345 (they asked to include it on any reissued documents)

Attached: Lumilist_INV-202601.pdf (PDF, 214 KB)

Thanks,
Maya Irwin
Senior Finance Manager
Lumilist
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Maya Irwin <maya.irwin@lumilist.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-28T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike on Jan invoice — temporary hold and next steps

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and for attaching INV-202601. I've flagged this to Billing and Finance and placed a temporary hold on collections for the unpaid balance so your AP team won't receive dunning notices while we investigate.

Next steps: 
- Jordan will pull the usage detail lines and propose a provisional goodwill credit to cover the anomalous ingestion spike.
- I'd like Lumilist to send the VAT certificate (if any) and confirm the PO LUM-PO-3345 so we can reissue the corrected invoice with the PO and VAT routing.

I've attached a short credit-request checklist that speeds approvals. If you can provide the VAT certificate and confirm the PO by EOD tomorrow we'll aim to issue a provisional credit note within 48 hours.

Attachments: redwood_credit_request_checklist.pdf (stub)

Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Maya Irwin <maya.irwin@lumilist.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-29T08:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike on Jan invoice — provisional credit proposal

Hi all,

I pulled the invoice detail. The spike is driven by a one-off migration ingest between 2026-01-12 and 2026-01-14 (high token counts from an external batch). Based on our internal rate card I'm proposing a provisional goodwill credit of $12,450 to offset the excess tokens above Lumilist's expected baseline.

Notes / asks for reissue:
- Please confirm Lumilist VAT reg ID (for EU customers we need the VAT reg so we can zero-rate where appropriate).
- Confirm PO LUM-PO-3345 to appear on the credit note and reissued invoice.

I've attached a draft credit note (redwood_credit_draft.pdf) and the line-level export that documents the spike. Once Finance confirms we'll issue the credit and reissue INV-202601 as INV-202601-R1.

Attachment: redwood_credit_draft.pdf (PDF, 45 KB)

Jordan Blake
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Maya Irwin <maya.irwin@lumilist.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-30T07:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike on Jan invoice — VAT and PO attached

Thanks Jordan — confirmed. Attaching Lumilist's VAT certificate and the PO. We reviewed the usage lines and agree the migration window drove the volume. Please include PO LUM-PO-3345 on any reissued docs.

Attachments: lumilist_vat_certificate.pdf (PDF, 26 KB), Lumilist_INV-202601.pdf (original copy included per AP request)

Maya
